entities.summary: Bayil Arena is a stadium in Bayil, Baku, Azerbaijan. It was opened in 2012 and has a capacity of 3,200 spectators. The stadium is owned and operated by AFFA. Yalchin Mammadov is a current stadium manager. Bayil Stadium is a stadium in West Asia, established around 2012. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
